subject: MAP transfer + onboarding plan for HealthBridge (post-signature)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Amara Collins <amara.collins@healthbridge.com>, Jared Mills <jared.mills@healthbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP transfer + onboarding plan for HealthBridge (post-signature)

Team, and Amara —

Thanks again for signing — excited to get HealthBridge onto Redwood. Per our close last week, I’ve attached the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the fully executed SOW for your records. I’m starting the handoff to Customer Success so they can run the onboarding and evaluation cadence.

Quick summary (high level):
- Goal: 8-week evaluation with production pilot by week 10
- Key milestones: Kickoff (week 0), Data access + integration (wk 1–2), Model evaluation & prompts (wk 3–5), Training for power users (wk 6), Pilot go-live (wk 8)
- Success criteria: 1) end-to-end latency < 250ms median for core flows, 2) embedding similarity >= 0.78 on eval set, 3) <1% error rate on API surface during pilot

Ownership (proposed):
- Sales (post-sign): Stephanie Nguyen — transitional owner until handoff complete
- CS Lead: Marcus Lin — ongoing customer success/ops owner
- Onboarding Engineer: Monica Patel — technical runbook & integration lead
- HealthBridge PM: Amara Collins — primary customer stakeholder

Attachments included: MAP_HealthBridge_v1.xlsx (tabbed: milestones, responsibilities, risks) and SOW_HealthBridge_signed.pdf.

Marcus / Monica — could you please: 1) confirm you can run the kickoff the week of 6/22, 2) propose a 60–90m kickoff agenda, and 3) flag any immediate risks (e.g., data-sharing needs, legal/infra gating items)?

Amara / Jared — let us know if the milestones align with your internal QA/procurement windows. If procurement needs anything from our side (invoice info, PO process), I can loop in finance.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: MAP_HealthBridge_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_HealthBridge_signed.pdf (PDF, signed)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Amara Collins <amara.collins@healthbridge.com>, Jared Mills <jared.mills@healthbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP transfer + onboarding plan for HealthBridge (post-signature)

Thanks Stephanie — and congrats to the team. I’ll take primary ownership for the CS delivery.

Proposed next steps from CS:
1) Kickoff call — propose Wed 6/24 at 10:00 AM PT (60–75m). Agenda draft below. Please confirm availability.
2) Pre-kickoff checklist (to be completed before 6/24):
   • HealthBridge contact list (PM, infra, security, demo users)
   • Test dataset / sample requests (S3 path or secure upload link)
   • Required access (API keys, VPC peering or private endpoint details)
3) I'll open a shared onboarding Confluence and add the runbook. Monica — can you own the integration checklist and post any infra blockers by EOD Tuesday?

Draft kickoff agenda (60–75m):
- Intros & success criteria (10m)
- MAP walk-through & timeline (15m)
- Technical integration plan (20m)
- Eval plan & acceptance tests (10m)
- Risks / next steps / action items (10m)

Risks I already see: potential legal/regulatory requirement around PII retention — Amara, do you have a security contact we should include? Also Jared, if procurement needs a specific invoice format or PO number, please share.

Marcus Lin
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0133

From: Amara Collins <amara.collins@healthbridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jared Mills <jared.mills@healthbridge.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 20:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP transfer + onboarding plan for HealthBridge (post-signature)

Marcus / Stephanie — thanks, and congrats. Wed 6/24 10:00 AM PT works for us.

A couple of asks to bake into the MAP before kickoff:
- Can you include the evaluation metrics (embedding similarity threshold and latency target) in the MAP's acceptance criteria tab? Will help our engineering team sign off.
- Procurement: we'll need a final invoice and tax form before the payment runs on 6/30. Jared, please coordinate with Redwood finance on invoicing format.

Security contact: Tom Wu (tom.wu@healthbridge.com) — please include him on the kickoff invite; he will review data residency/retention requirements.

Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Amara Collins
Product & Data Lead, HealthBridge
amara.collins@healthbridge.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amara Collins <amara.collins@healthbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP transfer + onboarding plan for HealthBridge (post-signature)

Adding a few technical notes for the pre-kickoff checklist:
- We’ll need (at minimum) a sample S3 bucket with representative data or a secure SFTP drop. If HealthBridge cannot share prod data, a sanitized sample will work.
- Network options: v1) VPC peering + private endpoint (preferred for latency), v2) public endpoint + IP allowlist. Please confirm which you prefer.
- Auth: we’ll provision scoped API keys for the evaluation project; for long-term please indicate if you plan to use KMS/HSM for keys.
- Data retention: what is HealthBridge's required retention window for logs and KV cache? This impacts our retention config and the MAP risk tracker.

I’ll start the integration checklist and post to the Confluence space once Marcus confirms the kickoff time.

Monica Patel
Onboarding Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP transfer + onboarding plan for HealthBridge (post-signature)

Perfect — thank you all. Confirming the kickoff for Wed 6/24 10:00 AM PT; I’ll send the calendar invite with the above agenda and Confluence link.

Responses to open items:
- Evaluation metrics: updated the acceptance criteria tab in MAP_HealthBridge_v1.xlsx to include the embedding similarity and latency targets Amara requested.
- Procurement: Jared — Stephanie from our finance team (cc'd on the invite) will follow up on invoice format. DocuSign link for the SOW: https://www.docusign.net/recipient?env=na1&token=ABCD1234
- Security contact: Tom Wu included on the invite; Monica — please copy him on the integration checklist and data-retention options.
- HubSpot/Deal link for CS: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/45231/HB-2026-089 — Marcus, you can use this for status updates and playbook notes.

Action items (summary):
1) Marcus: create Confluence onboarding space + send invite (by EOD 6/17).
2) Monica: post integration checklist and network options (by 6/18).
3) Amara/Jared: confirm procurement invoice format and provide sample dataset or upload link (by 6/19).
4) Stephanie: monitor procurement and clear any billing holds; remain on transitional cadence until post-kickoff.

If anything changes I’ll loop in Grace for executive escalation. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Stephanie
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
